codes.meaning: Current local time assessment is sufficiently trustworthy for configured security-sensitive expiry decisions.
Observed wall clock is earlier than the persisted trusted anchor beyond configured tolerance.
Time confidence is insufficient for a security-sensitive expiration/not-before decision; fail closed or require trusted recovery.
Configured trusted time source is unavailable; local policy determines whether existing local evidence is sufficient.
The protected record/action is past its accepted expiration boundary.
The protected record/action is before its accepted not-before/effective boundary.
Wall clock moved materially forward; expiry may become earlier but prior expired authority is not resurrected if time later moves back.
An authenticated trusted administrative flow explicitly restored local time confidence under policy.
